name: Monclova low n slow
for: brisket, beef ribs, burnt ends, trisket (tri-tip cooked like a brisket), pulled pork
notes: Hector 10-28: 200 from ignition for 2 hours, 225 to the stall (20 min without a single degree), 250 right away, an hour later 275 to 197, wrap in butcher paper with beef tallow and off the smoker to rest. Cook done: the pit drops to 150; the meat rests to 160-155, then the hold at 150 (smoker or oven) as long as he can, 12 hours even better.

pit.name: Ignition
pit.tell: Monclova low n slow: pit at 200 for the first 2 hours.

pit.name: Low
pit.tell: 2 hours in, meat {meat}°F. Pit to 225 until the stall.

pit.name: Bump
pit.tell: Stall: the meat sat at {meat}°F for 20 minutes. Pit to 250.

pit.name: Push
pit.tell: An hour at 250, meat {meat}°F. Pit to 275 until 197.

pit.name: Wrap
pit.tell: Meat {meat}°F: wrap it in butcher paper with beef tallow and take it off to rest. Tap Cook done: the pit drops to 150 for the hold.
